title: A/H科技开盘确认：中际旭创双市场走强、行云科技获正反馈，英力特复牌跌停 + 美股盘前：NVDA暴涨后回吐，纳指期货跌1.11%；HPE重挫11%
summary: 截至11月24日10:16 CST，上证指数涨0.80%、创业板指涨2.57%，A股科技反弹延续。中际旭创A股涨6.13%至442.78元、H股涨7.11%至550港元，回购与隔夜CPO映射获得双市场价格确认，但两地均较开盘高点明显回落；行云科技涨8.80%至23.61元，2.99亿元算力服务合同获得初步确认。英力特复牌跌停至9.90元，重组定价与审批风险被负面价格反馈强化；圣诺医药-B延迟行情无成交，折价配售回避结论不变。08:34后未发现改变主线的新增重大政策或公告。 截至05:26 ET，道指、标普500与纳指100期货分别下跌0.14%、0.46%和1.11%。NVDA在周一暴涨31.5%后盘前回落4.4%，MU、AMD与MRVL跌3.3%至4.3%，CRWV跌5.4%；HPE财报后跌11.1%。FLNC因创纪录订单与积压上涨约16%，Agilent业绩与展望超预期后涨约6.8%，Best Buy上调全年展望后小幅上涨。

美股夜盘行情总结

指数确认
指数确认
11月23日现金时段道指、标普500、纳指分别涨3.01%、4.73%、6.51%，确认AI链超跌修复；11月24日08:20 CST道指与标普期货约+0.1%、纳指100期货约-0.1%，显示反弹后暂歇。
板块背离
板块背离
NVDA、AXTI、FFR、XCH、LINK、SKYQ、OSCR、AIOK、PROP、DDS、SKHY在本轮没有可核验的运行时个股夜盘报价；行业/概念现金榜广度强，但当前纳指期货微跌，属于轻微背离。
A/H潜在反转
A/H潜在反转
截至10:16 CST，创业板涨2.57%；中际旭创A/H分别涨6.13%和7.11%、行云科技涨8.80%，隔夜半导体与CPU/IDC映射获得个股价格确认，但中际旭创从开盘高位回落，仍需观察承接。

盘前结论

事实：截至10:16 CST，上证涨0.80%、创业板涨2.57%；中际旭创A/H和行云科技上涨，英力特复牌跌停。

判断：隔夜半导体、CPU与IDC强势已在A/H算力链获得局部价格确认，中际旭创与行云科技可升级为看多候选，但前者高开后回落，追涨仍需控制。

不确定性：港股科技指数即时快照未取得；圣诺医药-B延迟行情无成交，折价配售回避结论不变。

重点个股关注

中际旭创
300308.SZ / 03308.HK
看多候选

确认条件：实际回购成交或订单交付继续验证，且A/H收盘维持对CPO与恒生科技的相对强势。
风险与失效条件：A股从463.20元开盘回落、H股从590.50港元开盘回落；若继续回吐并弱于板块，降回条件关注。

看多候选

回避

风险与失效条件：定价、审批、稀释或重组终止风险占优；在关键条款与价格反馈改善前维持回避。

重新评估条件：融资用途形成可量化里程碑，且成交恢复后股价站稳配售价与前收市价。
风险与失效条件：摊薄、资金消耗与临床研发不确定性延续时，维持回避，不能包装成融资利好。

板块轮动看板

结构线索

半导体、CPU、IDC、存储与硬件同步居前，直接映射A/H的CPO、算力服务器、芯片设备与存储链。

本地确认

中际旭创A/H分别涨6.13%和7.11%，行云科技涨8.80%，回购与算力合同获得初步价格确认。

压力方向

英力特复牌跌停，重组不确定性得到负面确认；圣诺医药折价配售仍缺成交消化。

验证信号

观察中际旭创高开回落后的承接、行云科技收盘强度、港股科技广度与美股期货后续方向。

逻辑链

隔夜半导体+18.00%、CPU概念+25.19%、IDC概念+24.97% → A/H科技开盘走强 → 中际旭创A/H和行云科技获得价格确认。
中际旭创大额回购 + 行云科技算力合同 → 公司级催化与隔夜主题同向 → 两者升级为看多候选，但仍需收盘与后续执行验证。
中际旭创A/H均大幅高开后回落 → 资金承接仍在但追涨风险上升 → 若继续回吐并弱于板块则降级。
英力特复牌跌停 + 圣诺医药折价配售无成交消化 → 交易、定价与稀释风险可核验 → 明确维持回避。

风险雷达

AI链单日涨幅极端，费城半导体指数涨14%、行业榜半导体涨18%，次日获利回吐和波动放大风险高。
英力特复牌跌停，且重组仍缺审计评估与最终定价，负面价格反馈与交易不确定性叠加。
圣诺医药配售价较前收市价折让12.16%，稀释和融资后现金消耗压力不能被忽略。
中际旭创A/H均从开盘高点明显回落；回购上限并非必然成交价或完成金额，执行节奏仍需公告验证。
本轮取得的东方财富行情为延迟快照，港股科技指数即时快照未取得；不把个股价格外推为全市场确认。

数据来源与时间点

增量搜索与公告核验截至2026-11-24 10:21 CST；08:34后未发现改变主线的新增重大政策或公告。A/H延迟行情：东方财富，个股约10:15 CST、指数约10:16 CST；上证+0.80%、创业板+2.57%，中际旭创A/H、行云科技与英力特价格反馈已逐项记录，港股科技指数即时快照未取得。基线行情：GitHub Actions AKShare快照；国际行情与排行沿用本次已验证的Reuters、Investor's Business Daily及Moomoo GitHub Actions快照。

PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 denotes importance, not price change.
Major News
Global
US AI stocks rebounded sharply, but volatility remains high
On Nov 23 the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 3.01%, 4.73% and 6.51%; Nvidia gained 31.5% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 14%. The move repaired part of last week's losses but did not remove valuation or policy risks. Source
Ranking
Semiconductors, hardware and data centers led overnight
The current snapshot shows semiconductors, semiconductor equipment, computer hardware, electrical equipment and electronic components up 10.58%-18.00%; CPU, IDC, blockchain, storage and brain-computer-interface concepts rose 18.08%-25.19%. Source
Overnight
Index futures were near flat after the cash-session rebound
Around 08:20 CST on Nov 24, Dow and S&P 500 futures were about +0.1% while Nasdaq-100 futures were about -0.1%. This is a mild divergence after the surge, not a confirmed reversal. Source
Policy
The first 18 active ETFs began trading
Nine first-batch active ETFs listed on each of the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges on Nov 23, raising about RMB36 billion in total. Broader products and transparency support the investment side but do not guarantee same-day inflows. Source
Policy
The elderly and childcare plan expands technology use
Four ministries set 2030 targets of 73% nursing-care beds and 70% community elder-care facility coverage, while encouraging smart management, health monitoring, service robots, wearables and exoskeletons. Source
Company
InnoLight plans a RMB2-4 billion A-share buyback
The price cap is RMB600 per share and the term is no more than three months. The stock closed at RMB417.20, up 6.10%, on Nov 23, but the announcement came after the close, so there is no post-announcement price confirmation yet. Source
Company
Xingyun signed a RMB299 million GPU compute-services contract
The company will provide 32 standardized GPU compute-service sets for five years, with a tax-inclusive value of RMB298.56 million. It was disclosed after the close; opening price/volume and collection execution remain unverified. Source
Company
Yinglite disclosed a Baofeng Solar restructuring plan and resumes trading
The company plans to buy 100% of Baofeng Solar through share issuance, while audit, valuation and final pricing remain incomplete. A control transfer and mandatory offer run in parallel, raising resumption volatility risk. Source
Hong Kong
Sirnaomics-B discounted placement creates dilution pressure
The company plans to issue 5.3354 million shares at HKD3.25, about 12.16% below the Nov 23 close of HKD3.70. Funding needs do not remove the immediate discount and dilution risk. Source
Market
A-share breadth was strong while Hong Kong tech lagged
AKShare data for Nov 23 showed Shanghai +0.15%, ChiNext +3.08%, with 4,658 advancers and 782 decliners. The 15:30 Hong Kong snapshot had Hang Seng TECH -0.07%, so local opening confirmation is still required. Source
Open
A-share tech extended the rebound, while company catalysts diverged
At 10:16 CST, Shanghai was +0.80% and ChiNext +2.57%. InnoLight A/H rose 6.13% and 7.11%, Xingyun gained 8.80%, while Yinglite hit the down limit after resuming. InnoLight had retreated from opening highs in both markets, keeping gap-up reversal risk alive. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Index confirmation
Index confirmation
The Nov 23 cash session confirmed an AI rebound with the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq up 3.01%, 4.73% and 6.51%. At 08:20 CST on Nov 24, Dow and S&P futures were about +0.1% and Nasdaq-100 futures about -0.1%, showing a pause after the rebound.
Sector divergence
Sector divergence
No verifiable runtime overnight quotes were obtained for NVDA, AXTI, FFR, XCH, LINK, SKYQ, OSCR, AIOK, PROP, DDS or SKHY. Cash-session industry/concept breadth was strong, while slightly negative Nasdaq futures represent a mild divergence.
Potential A/H reversal
Potential A/H reversal
At 10:16 CST ChiNext was +2.57%; InnoLight A/H rose 6.13% and 7.11% and Xingyun gained 8.80%. The US chip and CPU/IDC mapping received stock-level price confirmation, though InnoLight retreated from its opening highs and still needs follow-through.

Pre-market Takeaway

Fact: At 10:16 CST Shanghai was +0.80% and ChiNext +2.57%; InnoLight A/H and Xingyun rose, while Yinglite hit the down limit after resuming.

View: Overnight strength in chips, CPU and IDC received partial confirmation in the A/H compute chain. InnoLight and Xingyun can be upgraded to bullish candidates, but InnoLight faded from its opening highs, so chasing remains risky.

Uncertainty: No current Hang Seng TECH snapshot was obtained. Sirnaomics-B showed no trades in the delayed feed, so the discounted-placement avoid call remains unchanged.

Key Stock Focus

InnoLight
300308.SZ / 03308.HK
Bullish Candidate
Facts/status: Planned RMB2-4 billion A-share buyback with a RMB600 cap. At 10:15 CST the A share was RMB442.78, +6.13%, and the H share HKD550, +7.11%, outperforming local benchmarks. Source
Confirmation: Actual buyback execution or order delivery, with both shares maintaining relative strength versus CPO and Hang Seng TECH into the close.
Risk/invalidation: The A share fell from its RMB463.20 open and the H share from HKD590.50. Continued fading below sector strength would downgrade it to conditional watch.
Xingyun Technology
300209.SZ
Bullish Candidate
Facts/status: Signed a RMB298.56 million five-year GPU compute-services contract. At 10:15 CST it was RMB23.61, +8.80%, initially outperforming the market. Source
Confirmation: Price/volume strength holds into the close, followed by evidence on delivery, acceptance and cash collection.
Risk/invalidation: A gap-up reversal or loss of relative strength, or worsening order concentration, capex and collection risk, would downgrade it to conditional watch.
Yinglite
000635.SZ
Avoid
Facts/status: Plans to acquire 100% of Baofeng Solar through share issuance, with valuation and pricing unfinished. At 10:15 CST it hit the down limit at RMB9.90 after resuming, reinforcing negative price feedback. Source
Reassessment: The down limit opens with sustained support, volatility subsides, and audit valuation, issuance terms and approvals become clear.
Risk/invalidation: Pricing, approval, dilution and termination risks dominate; maintain avoid until terms and price action improve.
Sirnaomics-B
02257.HK
Avoid
Facts/status: Plans to place 5.3354 million shares at HKD3.25, a 12.16% discount to the prior HKD3.70 close. The 10:15 CST delayed feed showed HKD3.70 with no trades, providing no evidence that dilution has been absorbed. Source
Reassessment: Funding produces measurable milestones and, after trading resumes, the share price regains the placement price and prior close.
Risk/invalidation: Dilution, cash burn and clinical uncertainty keep the stock at avoid; funding cannot be repackaged as an immediate positive.

Sector Rotation Board

Structural signal

Semiconductors, CPU, IDC, storage and hardware all rank near the top, mapping directly to A/H CPO, compute servers, chip equipment and storage.

Local confirmation

InnoLight A/H rose 6.13% and 7.11%, while Xingyun gained 8.80%, giving initial confirmation to the buyback and compute contract.

Pressure

Yinglite hit the down limit, negatively confirming restructuring uncertainty. Sirnaomics still lacks trading evidence that the discounted placement has been absorbed.

Validation signals

Watch support after InnoLight's gap-up fade, Xingyun's closing strength, Hong Kong tech breadth and the next move in US futures.

Logic Chain

US semiconductors +18.00%, CPU concepts +25.19% and IDC concepts +24.97% → A/H tech opened stronger → InnoLight A/H and Xingyun received price confirmation.
InnoLight buyback + Xingyun compute contract → company catalysts aligned with the overnight theme → both upgrade to bullish candidates, subject to closing and execution evidence.
InnoLight A/H both faded from large opening gaps → support remains but chasing risk increased → downgrade if fading continues below sector strength.
Yinglite limit-down + no trading absorption for Sirnaomics placement → pricing, transaction and dilution risks are verifiable → maintain avoid.

Risk Radar

The one-day AI move was extreme: the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 14% and the industry ranking 18%, creating high profit-taking and volatility risk.
Yinglite hit the down limit after resuming while audit, valuation and final pricing remain unfinished, combining negative price feedback with deal uncertainty.
Sirnaomics' placement price is 12.16% below the prior close; dilution and post-financing cash-burn pressure remain material.
InnoLight A/H faded materially from opening highs. The buyback cap is not a guaranteed execution price or amount, and implementation still requires announcements.
The Eastmoney quotes used here are delayed snapshots, and no current Hang Seng TECH snapshot was obtained. Stock-level moves are not extrapolated to the entire market.

Sources and Timestamps

Incremental search and announcement checks ran through 2026-11-24 10:21 CST; no major policy or filing after 08:34 changed the core thesis. Delayed A/H quotes: Eastmoney, stocks around 10:15 CST and indices around 10:16 CST. Shanghai was +0.80% and ChiNext +2.57%; price feedback for InnoLight A/H, Xingyun and Yinglite was recorded individually, while a current Hang Seng TECH snapshot was unavailable. Baseline market data came from the GitHub Actions AKShare snapshot; international markets and rankings retain the already validated Reuters, Investor's Business Daily and Moomoo GitHub Actions sources.

05:26 ET，道指、标普500与纳指100期货分别跌0.14%、0.46%和1.11%，周一暴涨后的获利回吐集中在高贝塔科技。
科技
NVDA暴涨后回落
NVDA周一因黄仁勋重任CEO而暴涨31.5%，周二盘前回落4.4%；这更像事件冲击后的价格消化，不是新的利空事实。
科技
芯片链同步降温
MU、AMD与MRVL盘前跌3.3%至4.3%，显示NVDA回吐已扩散至存储、CPU与连接芯片。
科技
云算力继续承压
CRWV跌5.4%，IREN跌逾4%、NBIS跌4.3%，AI基础设施的融资与估值敏感度仍高。
宏观
加息定价压制估值
利率市场已完全计入12月加息25基点，并保留小概率50基点情景；周三PCE将成为主要验证。
财报
HPE出现明确负反馈
HPE财报后盘前跌11.1%，价格反馈不支持把业绩标题包装为多头催化。
公司
FLNC订单与积压获正反馈
Fluence披露季度订单35亿美元、积压89亿美元，盘前涨约16%；但收入不及预期、净亏损与交付节奏仍是反证。
公司
Agilent业绩与指引超预期
Agilent季度营收20.4亿美元、调整后EPS 1.86美元，并给出高于预期的FY2027展望，盘前涨约6.8%。
零售
Best Buy上调全年展望
Best Buy调整后EPS 1.62美元、营收102.4亿美元、同店销售增6.1%，均高于预期；上调全年展望后盘前小幅上涨。
财报
ADI与MDT未获价格确认
ADI虽超预期但指引偏混合、盘前跌逾7%；MDT EPS仅小幅超预期且营收不及预期、跌逾3%，两者均列风险而非推荐。

盘前结论

事实：期指转弱，NVDA、芯片与云算力链回吐；HPE、ADI和MDT出现负面价格反馈，FLNC、Agilent与Best Buy获得正反馈。

判断：预计科技主导低开或弱开，短线更接近周一暴涨后的获利回吐，而非已确认的新一轮系统性下跌；能否收复盘前跌幅取决于NVDA和SOX开盘承接。

不确定性：周三PCE、12月加息幅度、长端收益率和高波动财报都可能改变估值路径；盘前报价也可能在开盘前快速变化。

重点个股推荐

Fluence Energy
FLNC
订单正反馈

推荐理由：盘前涨约16%，创纪录35亿美元订单与89亿美元积压获得明确价格确认。

触发因素：开盘后守住跳空区，且成交量与清洁能源储能同业相对强势。

风险点：收入不及预期、净亏损、项目交付和现金消耗可能令涨幅快速回吐。

Agilent Technologies
A
业绩正反馈

推荐理由：调整后EPS 1.86美元并给出高于预期的FY2027收入与EPS区间，盘前涨约6.8%。

触发因素：开盘后在纳指偏弱背景下仍守住大部分涨幅，生命科学工具板块同步改善。

风险点：盘前相对成交量偏低，指引兑现与科研、医药资本开支放缓是主要风险。

Best Buy
BBY
零售正反馈

推荐理由：EPS、营收与同店销售均超预期并上调全年展望，盘前约涨1%。

触发因素：开盘后相对零售板块保持强势，且不回补业绩跳空。

风险点：假日需求、促销强度与毛利率波动可能削弱上调展望的含金量。

板块轮动看板

相对强势

储能、生命科学工具与消费电子零售；优先看FLNC、A与BBY能否守住业绩跳空。

主要压力

半导体、AI云算力与企业硬件；NVDA、MU、AMD、MRVL、CRWV和HPE均承压。

事件分化

财报标题不能替代价格确认：ADI与MDT未获确认，FLNC与Agilent获得确认。

验证信号

NVDA能否收复盘前跌幅、SOX是否止跌、VIX能否回落，以及10年期收益率是否脱离4.9%附近。

逻辑链

NVDA周一暴涨31.5% → 单日涨幅过大带来获利了结 → 周二盘前回落4.4%。
NVDA回吐与加息定价叠加 → 芯片和云算力同步走弱 → 纳指100期货跌1.11%。
FLNC、Agilent与Best Buy业绩后上涨 → 个股催化仍有效 → 资金并非无差别去风险。
若NVDA与SOX开盘止跌且VIX回落 → 指数可能收复部分跌幅；反之科技弱势可能扩散。

盘后财报 beat 概率

高（约70%）
Dell Technologies（DELL）
一致预期EPS约6.55-6.62美元、营收约493亿美元；最近四季连续beat，上季7.04美元高于4.91美元预期，近90天预期显著上修。AI服务器需求支持beat，但共识已很高、期权隐含波动约17.2%。该概率为判断，不是确定事实。
高（约65%）
Workday（WDAY）
一致预期EPS约2.74美元、营收约26.9亿美元；最近四季均beat，上季2.75美元高于2.61美元，近90天预期由2.64升至2.74。订阅增速和前瞻指引仍可能压过单季结果。该概率为判断，不是确定事实。
中（约55%）
Autodesk（ADSK）
一致预期EPS约3.07美元、营收约21.3亿美元；最近四季均beat，上季3.30美元高于3.12美元。但当前季预期从90天前3.14降至3.07，近30天向下修正占优。该概率为判断，不是确定事实。
中低（约45%）
HP Inc.（HPQ）
一致预期EPS约0.75-0.76美元、营收约154-156亿美元；上季0.83美元高于0.66美元，公司指引0.69-0.79覆盖共识。收入修正改善，但PC周期、利润率与混合EPS修正限制把握。该概率为判断，不是确定事实。

风险雷达

周一暴涨后仓位拥挤，NVDA与高贝塔AI股可能继续获利回吐。

12月加息已被完全计价，周三PCE偏热可能推高收益率并压缩科技估值。

VIX约28且走高，盘中振幅和开盘滑点风险仍大。

FLNC、A与BBY的盘前正反馈可能因成交量不足或指引细节而逆转。

DELL、WDAY、ADSK与HPQ盘后财报可能放大硬件、软件与PC链波动。

Major News
Macro
Futures weaken as technology leads
At 05:26 ET, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 futures fell 0.14%, 0.46% and 1.11%; profit taking after Monday's surge centered on high-beta technology.
Tech
NVDA retreats after Monday's surge
NVDA jumped 31.5% Monday after Jensen Huang returned as CEO, then fell 4.4% premarket Tuesday. This is price digestion after an event shock, not a new negative fact.
Tech
Chip weakness broadens
MU, AMD and MRVL fell 3.3%-4.3%, showing the NVDA giveback spreading to memory, CPUs and connectivity chips.
Tech
Neoclouds remain under pressure
CRWV fell 5.4%, IREN more than 4% and NBIS 4.3%; financing and valuation sensitivity remain high across AI infrastructure.
Macro
Rate pricing weighs on valuations
Rates markets fully price a 25bp December hike and retain a small chance of 50bp. Wednesday's PCE is the main macro test.
Earnings
HPE gets clear negative feedback
HPE fell 11.1% premarket after results, so the price response does not support treating the earnings headline as bullish.
Company
FLNC orders and backlog get positive feedback
Fluence reported $3.5bn of quarterly orders and an $8.9bn backlog, lifting shares about 16%; a revenue miss, net loss and delivery timing remain counterevidence.
Company
Agilent beats and guides above expectations
Agilent posted $2.04bn revenue, adjusted EPS of $1.86 and an above-consensus FY2027 outlook; shares rose about 6.8% premarket.
Retail
Best Buy raises its full-year outlook
Best Buy's adjusted EPS of $1.62, $10.24bn revenue and 6.1% comparable sales beat expectations; shares rose modestly after the outlook increase.
Earnings
ADI and MDT lack price confirmation
ADI beat but gave a mixed outlook and fell more than 7%; MDT narrowly beat EPS but missed revenue and fell over 3%. Both remain risks, not recommendations.

Premarket Takeaway

Facts: Futures weakened as NVDA, chips and neoclouds gave back gains. HPE, ADI and MDT saw negative feedback, while FLNC, Agilent and Best Buy saw positive feedback.

View: Technology likely drives a lower or weaker open. For now this looks closer to profit taking after Monday's surge than a confirmed new systemic leg down; recovery depends on opening support in NVDA and the SOX.

Uncertainty: Wednesday PCE, the size of the December hike, long yields and high-volatility earnings can change the valuation path. Premarket quotes can also move rapidly before the open.

Stock Picks

Fluence Energy
FLNC
Order confirmation

Rationale：Shares rose about 16% as record $3.5bn orders and an $8.9bn backlog received clear positive price confirmation.

Trigger：Hold the earnings gap after the open, with strong volume and relative strength versus storage peers.

Risk：The revenue miss, net loss, project delivery and cash burn could reverse the gap quickly.

Agilent Technologies
A
Earnings confirmation

Rationale：Adjusted EPS of $1.86 and above-consensus FY2027 revenue and EPS ranges lifted shares about 6.8%.

Trigger：Hold most of the gain despite Nasdaq weakness while life-science tools improve as a group.

Risk：Thin premarket relative volume plus execution and research/pharma capex risks limit confidence.

Best Buy
BBY
Retail confirmation

Rationale：EPS, revenue and comparable sales beat, and management raised its full-year outlook; shares rose about 1%.

Trigger：Maintain relative strength versus retail and avoid filling the earnings gap after the open.

Risk：Holiday demand, promotions and gross-margin volatility can dilute the outlook upgrade.

Sector Rotation

Relative strength

Storage, life-science tools and consumer-electronics retail; watch whether FLNC, A and BBY hold their earnings gaps.

Main pressure

Semiconductors, AI neoclouds and enterprise hardware; NVDA, MU, AMD, MRVL, CRWV and HPE are weaker.

Event split

Earnings headlines do not replace price confirmation: ADI and MDT lack it, while FLNC and Agilent have it.

Validation

Watch whether NVDA recovers, the SOX stabilizes, VIX falls and the 10-year yield moves away from 4.9%.

Logic Chain

NVDA surged 31.5% Monday → an outsized one-day move invites profit taking → shares fall 4.4% premarket Tuesday.
NVDA's giveback plus hawkish rate pricing → chips and neoclouds weaken together → Nasdaq-100 futures fall 1.11%.
FLNC, Agilent and Best Buy rise after results → idiosyncratic catalysts still work → risk reduction is not indiscriminate.
If NVDA and the SOX stabilize while VIX falls → indexes can recover part of the loss; otherwise technology weakness can broaden.

After-hours Earnings Beat Probability

High (~70%)
Dell Technologies (DELL)
Consensus is about $6.55-$6.62 EPS on roughly $49.3bn revenue. Dell beat in each of the last four quarters, including $7.04 versus $4.91 last quarter, and estimates rose sharply over 90 days. AI servers help, but consensus is demanding and options imply about a 17.2% move. This is judgment, not certainty.
High (~65%)
Workday (WDAY)
Consensus is about $2.74 EPS on $2.69bn revenue. Workday beat in each of the last four quarters, including $2.75 versus $2.61, and the estimate rose from $2.64 over 90 days. Subscription growth and forward guidance can still outweigh the quarter. This is judgment, not certainty.
Medium (~55%)
Autodesk (ADSK)
Consensus is about $3.07 EPS on $2.13bn revenue. Autodesk beat in each of the last four quarters, including $3.30 versus $3.12, but the estimate fell from $3.14 over 90 days and recent revisions skewed lower. This is judgment, not certainty.
Medium-low (~45%)
HP Inc. (HPQ)
Consensus is about $0.75-$0.76 EPS on $15.4-$15.6bn revenue. Last quarter's $0.83 beat $0.66 and company guidance of $0.69-$0.79 contains consensus. Better revenue revisions help, but PC cyclicality, margins and mixed EPS revisions cap confidence. This is judgment, not certainty.

Risk Radar

Crowded positioning after Monday's surge could extend profit taking in NVDA and high-beta AI.

A December hike is fully priced; hot Wednesday PCE could lift yields and compress tech multiples.

VIX is near 28 and rising, leaving large intraday ranges and opening slippage risk.

Positive premarket feedback in FLNC, A and BBY can reverse on low volume or guidance details.

After-hours DELL, WDAY, ADSK and HPQ results can amplify hardware, software and PC-chain volatility.
